title: Make a native screen
summary: A View groups native page parts. Text displays words.
introduction: A View groups native page parts. Text displays words. Your task: Change the screen greeting.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for make a native screen

blocks.text: A View groups native page parts. Text displays words. These components are the building blocks of a React Native screen.
Use a current Expo project with React Native. Put examples in App.jsx. Run the project with Expo on a supported device or emulator. Native components do not run in this website's HTML playground.

blocks.code:
import {View,Text} from "react-native";
export default function App(){return <View style={{padding:24}}><Text>Reading club</Text></View>;}
blocks.title: Make a native screen

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: View groups the screen parts and applies padding.
Text is the native component that can contain these words.

blocks.text: The app screen shows Reading club with inner space around it.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Text must be inside a Text component. A browser h1 or div is not a React Native component.
